description: On desktop, quick ask's box (the ask window, HAL-18787) gets only the commands its page calls (HAL-19004, studio.ask-box-window): reopen_folder, to open the workspace Studio last had open, which reopens only a folder the person picked in Studio; host_settings_read, for the active account; agent_host_request, to list the agents, send the question and wait for the answer through the agent host, which holds every key; show_main_window, for Open Studio and Open Halonic; plugin:quick-ask|hide, on Esc or a click beside the box, which takes nothing, hides only the calling window and is refused from any other; and plugin:quick-ask|open_chat (HAL-19097), for Open in Messenger, Answer in Messenger and Last answer, which takes one opaque conversation ID, which the shell only checks for length and hands to Messenger's page, hides the box and is refused from any other window. Nothing else is granted to this window: no secrets or tokens, trust, sandbox, workspace key, files, engine or runs. The box can't read or change its keys, and no page can register a key or hear one. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets nothing.
